latest_release.body:
- Added `g:plug_disable_credential_helper` (default: 1). Set it to 0 to keep the git credential helper enabled (#1047)
- Allowed command modifiers for on-demand-loading commands, e.g. `:tab Git diff` (#1110) (@subnut)
- Used the job API for `system()` calls in GUI Vim to reduce overhead (#1325) (@jgb)
- Made on-demand loading faster
    - Used `isdirectory()` to check plugin directories (#1340) (@mattn)
    - Skipped `BufRead` for an unnamed empty buffer (#1341) (@mattn)
- Stopped loading Python and Ruby libraries when they are not needed (#1344) (@Coacher)
- Fixed `PlugStatus` reporting divergence when a tag is specified (#1321) (@EESchneider)
- Fixed vim-plug commands on Windows when `&shell` is set to PowerShell (#1326, #1331) (@tiamat18)
